claims: DELUSER removes live users and terminates sessions, not persisted ACL file.

AOF loading can service clients; write/fsync failure under always exits.
Flush AOF before pending replies for always fsync.
ACL loads before listeners; listeners precede AOF loading and readiness.
AOF_FAILED/AOF_OPEN_ERR exit; AOF_NOT_EXIST/AOF_EMPTY not equivalent to failure.
CONFIG REWRITE skips inline user rewrite with external aclfile; not ACL SAVE.
Self-deleting current client closes after command; other revoked clients close asynchronously.
ACL DELUSER has LOADING command flag.
ACL SAVE saves effective ACL file and has LOADING flag.
AUTH has LOADING and NO_AUTH flags; denied AUTH can occur without completed load.

Comments about typical process-crash safety are not exact-image cut calibration or storage guarantees.
RDB signature/checksum load validation; nonzero checksum mismatch is corruption, zero checksum is treated disabled.
